verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee ships first-party, ready-made scraper endpoints for specific targets: Google SERP, Amazon search, product and pricing, Walmart search and product, and YouTube search, metadata and subtitles. A developer can get structured data from these sites without building a scraper, and the CLI exposes these dedicated APIs too. However, the evidence shows no marketplace: no catalog of community or third-party scrapers, no browsing or publishing, and only a small fixed set of vendor-built endpoints. missing for 10: a marketplace or store of ready-made scrapers, coverage beyond a handful of vendor-chosen sites, third-party or community contributions, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a ready-made scraper from a marketplace instead of building one from scratch

citations.quote: Search Amazon and receive structured product results.
Search Walmart and receive structured product and facet data.
Retrieve detailed Google SERP data, including classic results, news, maps, shopping, images, Lens, AI mode, and ads.
Use the official ScrapingBee command-line interface for scraping, crawling, exports, schedules, and dedicated APIs.
